title: 5 explosive allegations from Trillanes after impeachment trial withdrawal
summary: Former senator Antonio Trillanes IV's media briefing paints a picture of what his impeachment trial testimony would have been like

blocks.text: Former senator Antonio Trillanes IV's media briefing paints a picture of what his impeachment trial testimony would have been like

MANILA, Philippines – Former senator Antonio Trillanes IV held a press conference on Friday, October 2, his first since he was dropped from the prosecution’s witness lineup in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.

In the press conference, Trillanes linked Sara Duterte to China, flagged a supposedly fictitious name in one of her companies, questioned her allegedly undeclared time deposits in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth, and took a swipe at presiding officer Chiz Escudero.
Rappler’s Dwight de Leon gives us a summary. – Rappler.com
